name: Webhook trigger
description: Runs a routine when a service posts to its webhook URL with its key. The key stays in your credential store; the payload reaches the bot marked as untrusted outside content. Webhooks reach your computer through a webhook.ingress plugin, the waifucave forwarder by default.

ingress.description: The webhook.ingress entry it comes in through (an entry id or a plugin id); the first one installed when left out.

webhook.ingress.doc: Ways for webhooks to reach a device: the waifucave forwarder, the user's cloud computer, a tunnel (§7).
